notes.title: Patch 0.23
notes.content:
Patchnotes 0.23

Bugfixes:

- main menu buttons clickable area was greater than the button in some resolutions
- flickering issues with the info panel

Additional Features/Content:

- added a grid overlay (only in low zoom levels)
- added a height view of the map
- added a height view with water 
- added a height view with water and water flow indications
- buildable objects are not deselected after building
- zoom while building
- game checks for compute shader support (there will be a warning if not)

Changes:

- small balancings of the water flow calculations
- grass and wheat grow slower
- game runs also in background now
